program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (tmpl (reduce (lambda (acc ci)
                                (if acc
                                    acc
                                    (reduce (lambda (acc2 cj)
                                              (if acc2
                                                  acc2
                                                  (let ((r0 (* ci 4))
                                                        (c0 (* cj 4)))
                                                    (if (for/or ((lr (range 0 3)))
                                                                (for/or ((lc (range 0 3)))
                                                                        (= (at g
                                                                               (+ r0 lr)
                                                                               (+ c0 lc))
                                                                           8)))
                                                        #f
                                                        (list r0 c0)))))
                                            #f
                                            (range 0 3))))
                              #f
                              (range 0 3)))
                (tr (fst tmpl))
                (tc (snd tmpl)))
           (build-grid h
                       w
                       (r c)
                       (if (or (= r 3) (= r 7) (= c 3) (= c 7))
                           5
                           (at g (+ tr (floor (/ r 4))) (+ tc (floor (/ c 4)))))))))
